第38章 再次诱惑和拿下徐长卿-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》

好几个是什么鬼？

这句话给他整不会了。

“算是有吧。”

“她是普通人还是艺人？”

宋柯继续追问。

“艺人。”

对于这个答案，张亚冬和宋柯并不意外。

魏沐长得帅，说话好听，又会唱歌，身边没几个红颜知己谁信啊。

老宋和老张都是八九十年代的音乐人，玩过摇滚和民谣。

那个年代比现在还疯狂。

虽然这两人长相抱歉，但音乐界看的是才华。

不提睡过好几个女神的张亚冬，就说老宋，年轻的时候身边有好几个果儿。

宋柯提醒道：“好。那你要注意，别搞出人命。”

魏沐白了他一眼：“我说老宋，你能不能盼我点好。”

“我这是提醒，以防万一。”

第一张专辑发售以后，这位太合麦田的新人王一定会大火。

人一旦大火，他身边所有的事都会被放在放大镜下观察。

尤其是感情生活！！

做明星必须要有强大的心理素质。

对于这点，老宋一点也不担心，这小子脸皮比城墙还厚，根本不在乎。

.........

晚上回去，魏沐躺在大床上，和刘施施煲电话粥。

这女人是夜猫子，经常熬夜玩游戏，还想拉着他一起玩。

可惜他这边没电脑，玩不成。

内鬼刘施施分享了一个八卦：“我跟你说个秘密。”

“秘密？”

“对。”，电话那头传来激动的声音。

“我不想听。”

听到这句话的刘施施噎了一下，你怎么不按套路出牌？

“啊啊啊，不行，你快听我说！！”

这姑娘倾诉欲望非常强烈，是个八卦小能手。

“好，我勉为其难听一下。”

“怎么回事？”

于是，她准备把今天下午的见闻讲一遍。

她知道魏沐想要出演徐长卿这个角色。

臭男人一直嘴硬，但还是被她看出来。

准男朋友有上进心，她这个大靠山当然要推一把。

而且只要对方拿下徐长卿，俩人就能天天在一起，毕竟她的角色可是紫萱。

俩人在戏里面是一对！！

一想到紫萱和徐长卿的亲热戏，刘施施就忍不住脸红。

当着这么多人的面，还挺不好意思。

What the hell are several of them?

He couldn't handle this sentence.

"So there is."

"Is she an ordinary person or an artist?"

Song Ke continued to ask.

"Artist."

Zhang Yadong and Song Ke were not surprised by this answer.

Wei Mu is handsome, speaks well, and can sing. Who would believe him if he doesn't have many confidants around him?

Lao Song and Lao Zhang were both musicians in the 1980s and 1990s, and played rock and folk music.

It was a crazier time than now.

Although these two look sorry, the music industry is looking for talent.

Not to mention Zhang Yadong, who slept with several goddesses, let’s talk about Lao Song. When he was young, he had several Guoer around him.

Song Ke reminded: "Okay. Then you have to be careful not to kill anyone."

Wei Mu rolled his eyes at him: "Old Song, can you hope that I will be better?"

"I'm just reminding you, just in case."

After the release of his first album, this newcomer from Taihe Maitian will definitely become a hit.

Once a person becomes angry, everything around him will be observed under a magnifying glass.

Especially love life!!

To be a star, you must have a strong psychological quality.

Lao Song was not worried at all about this. This guy was thick-skinned as the city wall and didn't care at all.

.........

When he went back at night, Wei Mu lay on the big bed and talked on the phone with Liu Shishi.

This woman is a night owl, often staying up late to play games, and she wants to drag him along to play.

It's a pity that he doesn't have a computer here, so he can't play.

The mole Liu Shishi shared a piece of gossip: "I'll tell you a secret."

"Secret?"

"Yes.", an excited voice came from the other end of the phone.

"I don't want to hear it."

Liu Shishi choked up when he heard this, why didn't you play according to the routine?

"Ah ah ah, no, please listen to me!"

This girl has a very strong desire to talk and is a good gossip.

"Okay, I'll try to make it harder for you."

"What's going on?"

So, she was going to tell her what she had seen this afternoon.

She knew that Wei Mu wanted to play the role of Xu Changqing.

The stinky man was always tough-talking, but she still noticed.

If the prospective boyfriend is ambitious, she, as a big supporter, will certainly give him a push.

And as long as the other party captures Xu Changqing, the two of them can be together every day. After all, her role is Zixuan.

The two of them are a couple in the play!!

Liu Shishi couldn't help but blush when he thought of the intimate scene between Zixuan and Xu Changqing.

It was quite embarrassing in front of so many people.
